markings.status.area_start: Markings: click the anchors round the area, then the first one again to close it.

markings.status.arrow_start: Markings: click a lane of an arm to lay this arrow there: {arrow}.
markings.done.curvature: Changed the curvature of the line
markings.click_junction: Click a junction made in this project.

markings.status.target: Markings of junction #{id}: click an anchor, then another to draw a line; click a line or an area to select it. Esc leaves the tool.
markings.status.start: Markings: click a junction made in this project to draw its road markings; Esc leaves the tool.
markings.status.first: Markings: click a junction made in this project first.
markings.status.three: An area needs three corners at least.
markings.status.corner_used: That anchor is a corner already; click the first corner to close the area.

markings.status.corner_more: Corner {n}: click the next anchor round the area.
markings.status.arrow_selected: Selected arrow: {arrow}; choose another kind or distance in the panel, Del deletes it.
markings.status.no_lanes: Junction #{id} has no lanes to suggest markings for.
markings.done.suggested: Put in {lines, plural, one {# suggested line} other {# suggested lines}}{replaced, plural, =0 {} one { in place of #} other { in place of #}}{gone, plural, =0 {} one {, without # area at crossings that went} other {, without # areas at crossings that went}}{arrows, plural, =0 {} one { and # arrow for the ways through the lanes} other { and # arrows for the ways through the lanes}}
markings.plan.next: Click the next anchor round the area, the first to close it; Esc lets go.
markings.plan.area_selected: Selected: {fill}. Choose another fill or stripe angle, or press Del.
markings.plan.arrow_selected: Selected: arrow {arrow}. Choose another kind or distance, or press Del.
markings.plan.draw: Click to draw a {style} to this anchor.
markings.plan.end: Click the anchor the line ends at; Esc lets go of this one.
markings.plan.line_selected: Selected: {style}{pieces, plural, =0 {} one {} other { in # pieces}}. Choose another style or curvature, hide the piece, or press Del.
markings.plan.lay: Click to lay the arrow {distance, number, 0.#} m behind the mouth{outward, select, yes {, pointing out of the junction as the lane runs.} other {.}}
markings.plan.arrow_point: Point at a lane of an arm to lay an arrow, or click an arrow to select it.
markings.plan.area_start: Click to start an area at this anchor.
markings.plan.area_pick: Click the anchors round an area, or an area to select it.
markings.plan.line_start: Click to start a line at this anchor.
markings.plan.line_pick: Click an anchor to start a line, or a line or an area to select it.
markings.status.line_end: Click the anchor the line ends at.
markings.status.area_next: Click the next anchor round the area, or the first one to close it; Esc lets go of the area.
markings.status.line_selected: Selected line: {style} and its piece under the pointer: choose another style or curvature in the panel, hide the piece, Y switches the style, Del deletes the line.
markings.status.area_selected: Selected area: {fill}: choose another fill or stripe angle in the panel, Del deletes it.
markings.status.only_made: Markings: click a junction made in this project; only those can carry markings drawn here.
markings.done.line_deleted: Deleted the line{dependent, plural, =0 {} one { and # line drawn from its crossings} other { and # lines drawn from its crossings}}{areas, plural, =0 {} one {, with # area at them} other {, with # areas at them}}
markings.status.done: {done} (junction #{id}); now {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, {areas, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}} and {arrows, plural, one {# arrow} other {# arrows}}, made again as {name}. Ctrl+Z takes it back.
markings.done.cli: Drew {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, {areas, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}} and {arrows, plural, one {# arrow} other {# arrows}}
markings.status.follow: Markings: click an anchor to start a line, or a line to select it; Esc leaves the tool.
markings.arrow.title: {arrow} arrow
markings.auto.tooltip: Puts in a suggestion after the right of way in place of the junction's lines: lane lines along the main road, a broken edge line across each side road and give-way lines on the side roads; stop lines on every arm without a main road. Areas and arrows stay. Ctrl+Z brings the lines back.
markings.whole_line.tooltip: Styles and curvature change the whole selected line
markings.this_piece.tooltip: A style changes only the piece of the line between crossings that was clicked
markings.piece.tooltip: Hides the clicked piece of the line between crossings, such as where a median crosses a turning lane; shows a hidden one again
markings.curvature.tooltip: How far the curve bulges between two arms, 0 to 80; empty bends it like a circle. Lines across one arm or from a crossing stay straight.
markings.angle.tooltip: The angle of an area's stripes from its longest side, counter-clockwise; 45 as the StVO has it, -45 leans them the other way.
markings.distance.tooltip: How far behind the mouth of its arm the selected arrow ends, in metres; a new arrow lies where its lane is clicked.
markings.delete.tooltip: Deletes the selected marking (Del); a line takes the lines and areas drawn from its crossings along
markings.keys: Y: next in its tab, Del: delete, Esc: let go.
markings.tab.lines.tooltip: Lines between two anchors: click one anchor, then another
markings.tab.areas.tooltip: Restricted areas (sign 298): click the anchors round one, then the first again
markings.tab.arrows.tooltip: Direction arrows (sign 297): click a lane of an arm
markings.tab.favorites.tooltip: Markings you marked with the star
markings.favorites_empty: Mark markings with the star to find them here.
